title: Vocabulary-size-independent Convergence of Discrete Diffusion Models: adjoint equations induce the right space
abstract: arXiv:2605.17232v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Discrete diffusion has become a leading framework for generative modeling in various applications including language, vision, and biology. Existing convergence theory, however, exhibits fundamental limitations. KL-based analyses diverge under singular priors such as the masked distribution, while bounds in total variation (TV) depend on the vocabulary size $S$ and become vacuous for modern language tasks, where vocabularies contain hundreds of thousands of tokens. We develop a unified adjoint-equation-based framework that establishes vocabulary-size-independent convergence guarantees in any integral probability metric (IPM). To the best of our knowledge, our bounds are the first to be entirely free of $S$ and applicable to both masked and uniform priors. translated_title: 离散扩散模型的词表规模无关收敛性：伴随方程诱导出正确的空间
translated_abstract: 离散扩散已成为包括语言、视觉和生物学在内的多种应用中生成建模的主流框架。然而，现有的收敛理论存在根本性的局限：基于KL散度的分析在诸如掩码分布等奇异先验下发散，而总变差（TV）下的界依赖于词表规模 $S$，对于拥有数十万词元的现代语言任务而言变得毫无意义。我们开发了一个基于伴随方程的统一框架，在任何积分概率度量（IPM）下建立了与词表规模无关的收敛保证。据我们所知，我们的界是首个完全摆脱 $S$ 且同时适用于掩码先验和均匀先验的结果。重要的是，我们的结果可以将现有的步数复杂度保证扩展到任意IPM。此外，我们的理论仅依赖单一标准的速率矩阵正则性假设，并适用于……
tldr: 本文提出基于伴随方程的统一理论框架，首次给出了完全与词表规模无关、适用于任意积分概率度量以及掩码和均匀先验的离散扩散模型收敛保证。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a unified adjoint-equation-based framework, providing the first convergence guarantees for discrete diffusion models that are entirely independent of vocabulary size, applicable to any integral probability metric, and valid for both masked and uniform priors.
